title: These look like such a great deal but in reality they are cheap and work POORLY.
text: These look like such a great deal but in reality they are cheap and work POORLY.. These look like such a great deal but in reality they are cheap and work POORLY.  Works ok for cookies and biscuits but thats about it.  They don't work on any meat products or potatoes.  Anything that you will have grease or oil forget it!  The grease soaks the paper and they are worthless, the potatoes stick to the cookie sheet, chicken sticks to the cookie sheet and the bacon grease leaves such a mess.  I have used many brands of parchment paper, even a roll from the dollar store, and those work twice as good as this does.  Its a waste of money!

product_metadata.title: Premium Quilon Parchment Sheets (white), 12x16 baking sheet pan liners (300 ct), exclusive recipe included
